name: multi-file-search
prompt: Find every place in the servers/ directory, ignoring *.spec.ts files, that writes a file under .omca/. List each writer as a source file with the .omca/ path it writes.
success_criteria: The response lists exactly these seven writers, each with its target: (1) servers/io.ts writes .omca/.gitignore; (2) servers/tools/boulder.ts writes .omca/state/boulder.json; (3) servers/tools/evidence.ts writes .omca/evidence/verification-evidence.json, and the monthly archive verification-evidence.<yyyymm>.json beside it; (4) servers/tools/notepad.ts writes .omca/notepads/<plan>/<section>.md; (5) servers/tools/filesystem.ts appends to .omca/logs/file-access.jsonl; (6) servers/tools/hook.ts appends to .omca/state/hook-trace.jsonl, only when OMCA_HOOK_TRACE=1; (7) servers/hooks/status-file.ts writes .omca/state/session/<session_id>.json. Mentioning the .lock files beside boulder.json, the ledger and the notepad sections is accepted. servers/lifecycle.ts only deletes files, so listing it as a writer is an error, and so is listing any file outside servers/ (hooks/mod-marker.ts, hooks/feedback.ts, src/core/ledger.ts).
